title: Access control policy
statement: Access control requirements are defined, documented, and approved by the authorized official.
evidence_examples: Approved access control policy; approval record; version history

title: Access control implementation
statement: The approved access control requirements are implemented across systems, applications, and information assets, and access is restricted accordingly.
evidence_examples: System access configurations; implementation records; access control matrix

title: Identity lifecycle management
statement: Every identity is unique, tied to an accountable person or system, and managed from creation to removal.
evidence_examples: Joiner, mover, leaver procedure; account creation and removal records; list of service accounts with owners

title: Authentication and credential management
statement: Users authenticate before access is granted, at minimum with a username and password, and passwords and other authentication secrets are issued, stored, and handled securely.
evidence_examples: Password policy; authentication configuration screenshots; credential issuance procedure

title: Multi-factor authentication
statement: Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access and privileged accounts, with factors and techniques chosen from an impact assessment of authentication failure.
evidence_examples: MFA configuration for remote access and privileged accounts; impact assessment; MFA enrolment report

title: Authorization principles
statement: Access is authorized on the basis of need-to-know, need-to-use, least privilege, and segregation of duties.
evidence_examples: Role and permission matrix; segregation of duties matrix; access request approvals

title: Privileged access management
statement: Privileged access rights are restricted, separately assigned, controlled, and monitored.
evidence_examples: Privileged account inventory; PAM tool configuration; privileged access approvals

title: Access rights provisioning, review, and revocation
statement: Access rights are granted through an approved process, reviewed periodically, adjusted when roles change, and revoked promptly when no longer needed or when employment ends.
evidence_examples: Periodic access review reports; revocation records for leavers; access change tickets

title: Periodic review of access control requirements
statement: The access control requirements and how they are implemented are reviewed at planned intervals and updated when needed.
evidence_examples: Policy review minutes; compliance review report; updated policy with change log

title: Access to source code
statement: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries is restricted and managed.
evidence_examples: Repository permission lists; branch protection settings; access reviews for code repositories
